scope.description: Four small separately owned installed Chrome child runs with process --force-device-scale-factor=1,1.5,2,3. Exact installed ToolCallTree CSS; synthetic 24px own cards with root-child-grandchild and sibling wrappers. No CDP Emulation methods, full app, React, live Session, hardware monitor or Electron claim.
scope.network: No page HTTP(S)/WS(S) requests: CSP denies, CDP blocks, DNS disabled. Runner connects only to its own verified loopback CDP endpoint; no app server.

protected.policy: No targeting, signalling, restarting, profiles, application requests, foreground or lock-screen manipulation.

limitations: Process-level device scale is real Chrome startup configuration, not CDP metrics emulation or a physical-monitor/hardware acceptance test.
Synthetic own cards are fixed 24 CSS px; only tree CSS and recursive wrapper relationships are from installed original output.
This separate scale measurement does not repeat the earlier geometry/picker interaction acceptance.
attemptPolicy: One invocation, each requested scale launched once. No acceptance rerun; failed measurements retained.
